messages.subject: embarrassingly parallelizations?
parts:
Hi!

The new ODE solver is shaping up, which is great! As most users will be using this in the context of hierarchical models, it would make sense to consider adding some mechanism which allows for embarassingly parallelism, i.e. evaluate the ODE for N patients in parallel and since due to the need for sensitivities and oftentimes many patients, this can be a very worthwhile thing todo. Of course, this would be beneficial in general, not only for ODE type models, but all hierarchical models with expensive model function evaluation.

Maybe this can be done with some type of openMP type statements? No idea, just a thought.

Best,
Sebastian
